body.purpose: Tables, descriptions, controls — the working size.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Modals, drawers, dropdown menus only — never resting cards (the Tonal Stack Rule).

motion.name: hero-crossfade
motion.purpose: Now Playing backdrop crossfade; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold-on-black primary action; calm at rest, no glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: linear-gradient(#0f1116, #000000); color: #ffc838; border: 1px solid rgba(245,181,21,0.35); border-radius: 12px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(11,14,19,0.9), 0 0 0 4px rgba(245,181,21,0.45); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive admin action; plain and explicit, never a showpiece.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: linear-gradient(#1a0e0e, #090000); color: #ffdede; border: 1px solid rgba(255,70,70,0.55); border-radius: 12px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(11,14,19,0.9), 0 0 0 4px rgba(239,68,68,0.45); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Workhorse utility control for filters and selectors.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #262626; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #404040; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #404040; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(11,14,19,0.9), 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Resting dashboard panel: tonal step + hairline border, no shadow.
components.html:
Top Users
42 users watched 1,204 hours
components.css: .ds-card { background: #121722; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 14px; color: #9aa4b2; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 14px; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Pill for counts, codecs, and server types.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(230,246,236,0.9); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: The dashboard's signature component: dark table with hairline rows and right-aligned numerics.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 14px; color: #ffffff; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-table thead th { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-align: left; padding: 12px 8px; } .ds-table tbody tr { border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-table td { padding: 12px 8px; } .ds-table .ds-num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header navigation link; hover tints toward gold.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #ffd54a; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(245,181,21,0.45); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview: Emby Analytics looks like the room where the machines live: dark, calm, and instrument-grade. Surfaces are deep near-black panels stacked in subtle tonal steps; the only light in the room comes from the data itself — gold chart bars, green status lights, live session art. The chrome never competes. If a screen feels bland, the answer is sharper data presentation, never more ornament on the frame.
keyCharacteristics: Deep, flat, near-black tonal stack (#0b0e13 → #121722 → #262626) with 1px hairline borders
One accent: gold (#ffc838) — used sparingly, where attention is earned
Green and red are status semantics (live / healthy / error), never decoration
System font stack, tight tracking on headings, data in tables and Nivo charts
Motion only on live surfaces (Now Playing); historical views are still

rules.name: The Single Lamp Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only accent in the chrome, and it covers no more than ~10% of any screen. If two things glow gold, neither is important.

rules.name: The Status Light Rule
rules.body: Green means live or healthy; red means failed or destructive. Neither color ever appears for decoration, branding, or emphasis.

rules.name: The Two-Second Rule
rules.body: Every card's headline reading (the number, the now-playing title, the trend) must be legible at a glance in Display/Title weight; supporting detail drops to Body below it.

rules.name: The Tonal Stack Rule
rules.body: A resting surface gets a background step and a hairline border, never a shadow. If you reach for a shadow, the element must be an overlay that can be dismissed.

dos: Do keep chrome neutral and let data carry the color — gold charts, status lights, session artwork (the Single Lamp Rule).
Do build depth with background steps (#0b0e13 → #121722 → #262626) and 1px hairline borders; reserve shadows for overlays.
Do keep body text at 14px/white or 14px/#9aa4b2 minimum contrast; tertiary white/50 text is for short captions only.
Do give every interactive element a visible keyboard focus ring and ≥44px touch targets on mobile.
Do provide a prefers-reduced-motion alternative for every animation, as the hero crossfade already does.
Do right-align numeric table columns and use the mono stack for codecs, bitrates, and IDs.
donts: Don't ship the "neon gamer aesthetic" PRODUCT.md forbids: no glow blooms, pulse keyframes, radial-gradient washes, or RGB-tinted borders. The legacy btn-premium bloom animation and the emerald body gradient are the named offenders — retire, don't imitate.
Don't ship the "generic SaaS dashboard" PRODUCT.md forbids: no grids of identical stat cards, no gradient hero metrics, no decorative icon+heading+text card rows.
Don't use Signal Green or Signal Red decoratively; they are status semantics only.
Don't introduce a second accent hue. Gold (#ffc838) is the lamp; everything else is neutral or status.
Don't put shadows on resting cards or nest cards inside cards.
Don't drop text below 12px or below Muted Ink (#9aa4b2) contrast for anything that must be read.
Don't animate historical/analytics surfaces; motion belongs to live data only.
